import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Separate features and target
target_col = "Cover_Type"
feature_columns = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "Id" and c != target_col]

X_train = train_df[feature_columns].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_columns].copy()
test_ids = test_df["Id"].copy()

# Create hold-out validation split from training data ONLY (20%)
# Check for class imbalance to determine if stratification is safe
class_counts = y_train.value_counts()
min_class_size = class_counts.min()

print(f"\nCover_Type classes: {train_df['Cover_Type'].nunique()}")
print(f"Minimum samples per class: {min_class_size}")

# Use stratified split only if all classes have enough samples
if min_class_size >= 50:
    stratify = y_train
    print("Using stratified split")
else:
    stratify = None
    print("Not using stratified split (some classes have few samples)")

# Train/validation split - 80/20 from training data
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=stratify
)

print(f"\nTraining fold: {X_train_fold.shape}")
print(f"Validation fold: {X_val.shape}")

# Handle missing values consistently - use training data median (BEFORE split leakage)
print("\nImputing missing values with training median...")
median_imputer = X_train.median(numeric_only=True)

X_train_fold = X_train_fold.copy().fillna(median_imputer)
X_val = X_val.copy().fillna(median_imputer)
X_test = X_test.copy().fillna(median_imputer)

print(f"Train missing after fill: {X_train_fold.isna().sum().sum()}")
print(f"Val missing after fill: {X_val.isna().sum().sum()}")
print(f"Test missing after fill: {X_test.isna().sum().sum()}")

# Train Random Forest with balanced class weights on fold data
print("\nTraining Random Forest on validation split...")
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=False,
)

rf_model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Predict on validation set and calculate accuracy
print("\nPredicting on validation set...")
y_val_pred = rf_model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Retrain on ALL training data for final submission (better generalization)
print("\nRetraining final model on all training data...")
X_train_all = X_train.fillna(median_imputer)

final_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=False,
)

final_model.fit(X_train_all, y_train)

# Predict on test set
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
y_test_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
print("\nCreating submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(
    f"Cover_Type distribution:\n{submission['Cover_Type'].value_counts().sort_index()}"
)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("Pipeline complete")
print("=" * 50)
